limitations: Source-reported model inference, not a direct binding/transient measurement or experimentally established elementary arrow sequence. No native-pyruvate KD is supplied.
The four net parameters share turnover and NMR inputs and are not four independent experimental confirmations. No numerical population fractions are reconstructed from their rounded values.
Each acid-quenched covalent species can pool forms with and without noncovalently associated substrate or product; quench state is not a full enzymatic microstate.

Source net constants include commitment to product rather than reversal. Lower k_prime_4 can arise from bond making or later k_prime_5; k_prime_5 can include covalent cleavage and product diffusion. No microscopic causal rate or residue energy follows.
Fig5 is a hypothetical E.coli active-site model based on yeast1N0H; Fig6 proposes WT/2-ketobutyrate transition-state interactions. Neither is a Met250Ala/Pyr+Pyr observed arrangement.
